zh.summary: 讓完整結果屬於確切的一份輸入；變更後重新檢查，匯出端再次驗證並只輸出允許欄位。
objectives: 用已檢查快照約束預覽與下載。
在輸入變更時使舊結果失效。
驗證匯出資料結構與負向輸入。

readingGuide.goal: 用已檢查快照約束預覽與下載。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 工作坊 reference/、瀏覽器、pytest 與自己的第二切片。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: app.py、rules.py、測試與下載驗收可追溯到同一份目前輸入。

sections.heading: 成功結果也有適用的資料範圍
paragraphs: 三欄完整後，使用者可能立即清空文件類型。如果程式只記住 complete=True，舊成功狀態就可能繼續顯示，讓目前缺件資料取得完整報告。
reference/ 是第三切片的教師解答。它保存通過時的資料副本，只有副本與目前輸入相同且規則仍通過時，才呈現完整預覽及下載。

sections.heading: 像簽名要對應那一版文件
paragraphs: 簽名確認的是當時那份內容；文件修改後，原簽名不能自動替新內容背書。檢查結果也應連到實際受檢的資料，而非只留下沒有對象的綠燈。
本機教學快照是字典副本與相等比較，不是密碼學簽章、正式稽核軌跡或多人一致性機制。需求若擴及資料庫與多人操作，要重新設計版本與授權。

sections.heading: 狀態保存、失效與重新檢查
paragraphs: Streamlit 的 Session State 可在同一使用者工作階段的重跑之間保存值。參考程式按檢查且無錯誤時保存 record.copy()；輸入提交變更時，on_change 回呼清掉 checked。
顯示端仍比較 checked 與 record 並再次檢查規則。這裡的快照與相等比較處理本課三個文字欄位，不推廣成所有物件或多人並行資料的通用解法。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜結果必須跟著資料版本
blocks.description: 流程含重新檢查條件；輸入變更後回到未檢查狀態。

items.title: 未檢查
items.body: 填寫或修改資料，只顯示操作指引。

items.title: 按檢查
items.body: 失敗列缺漏；通過保存目前值副本。

items.title: 預覽與匯出
items.body: 目前值等於快照且規則通過才可顯示。

items.title: 輸入變更
items.body: 清除快照與下載入口，回到重新檢查。

sections.heading: 匯出邊界不信任舊畫面旗標
paragraphs: rules.py 的 export_report 呼叫 report，report 先 validate；不合法就拋出 ValueError，無法僅憑畫面曾顯示成功就產生報告。匯出只取 FIELDS 允許的三鍵，避免把除錯或未約定欄位一起寫入下載。
下載 JSON 包含 status、scope、data；complete 僅代表教學三欄完整，scope 明寫不代表正式受理。三欄值先去除首尾空白，報告以 UTF-8 中文內容匯出；下載檔存在操作者裝置。

blocks.heading: 受控匯出範例
paragraphs: 結構是本課設計，並非正式單位格式。

sections.heading: 以完整、清空、再補正驗收
paragraphs: 從解壓根目錄進 reference，先跑測試，再啟動 app.py。先輸入三個有效合成值、按檢查，核對預覽並下載；接著清空文件類型、讓變更提交，確認舊完整結果與下載消失。
重新補齊後仍需按檢查。AppTest 檢查狀態與元素，真實瀏覽器另外核對下載位元組、中文及檔名；只看按鈕出現不能證明檔案內容正確。

blocks.heading: 執行第三切片
paragraphs: 和前兩階段分開執行，不覆蓋學員專案。
blocks.code:
cd reference
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: 完整狀態不能擴張成正式保證
paragraphs: 「前端禁用按鈕就夠了」漏掉直接匯出呼叫；「清掉 checked 就代表所有下載已刪除」則混淆工作階段狀態與裝置檔案。使用者已下載的資料仍需自行管理。
本課沒有登入、多人授權、持久儲存或安全刪除機制。將這些限制寫入驗收與交接，讓接手者知道本機原型目前能證明什麼。

exercise.environment: 工作坊 reference/、瀏覽器、pytest 與自己的第二切片。
steps: 新增快照、輸入變更失效、受控報告與匯出重新驗證。
測試完整後清空欄位，以及直接對不合法資料呼叫匯出；確認不能產生完整報告。
在真實瀏覽器下載 JSON，核對允許欄位、中文及範圍說明，記錄實際結果。
exercise.expected: app.py、rules.py、測試與下載驗收可追溯到同一份目前輸入。
exercise.check: 舊成功不能授權新資料匯出；額外鍵不進報告；已下載檔另行管理。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Bind a complete result to exact input, require rechecking after edits, and revalidate at export while emitting only allowed fields.
objectives: Constrain preview and download with a checked snapshot.
Invalidate the old result when input changes.
Verify the export structure and negative inputs.

readingGuide.goal: Constrain preview and download with a checked snapshot.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Workshop reference/, a browser, pytest and your second slice.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: app.py, rules.py, tests and download acceptance traceable to the same current input.

sections.heading: A Successful Result Applies to Particular Data
paragraphs: After all three fields pass, a user may immediately clear document type. If the program stores only complete=True, an old success may remain and let currently incomplete data obtain a complete report.
reference/ is the teacher solution for slice three. It keeps a copy of the passed data and presents complete preview/download only when the copy equals current input and the rules still pass.

sections.heading: A Signature Refers to That Version of a Document
paragraphs: A signature confirms particular content at a point in time. Editing the document does not make the old signature endorse the new content. A check result likewise needs an identifiable input rather than an unattached green light.

The teaching snapshot is a dictionary copy and equality comparison. It is not a cryptographic signature, formal audit trail or multiuser consistency mechanism. Database or concurrent-user needs require redesigned versioning and authorization.

sections.heading: Retain, Invalidate and Recheck State
paragraphs: Streamlit Session State retains values between reruns within a user session. After a check with no errors, the reference stores record.copy(); committing an input change invokes an on_change callback that clears checked.

The display condition also compares checked with record and checks the rules again. This snapshot/equality mechanism addresses three text fields; it is not a universal solution for arbitrary objects or concurrent multiuser data.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Results Must Follow the Data Version
blocks.description: The flow includes a recheck condition. Input changes return the record to an unchecked state.

items.title: Unchecked
items.body: Enter or edit data; show interaction guidance only.

items.title: Press check
items.body: List omissions on failure; store a copy of current values on success.

items.title: Preview and export
items.body: Show them only when current values equal the snapshot and rules pass.

items.title: Input changes
items.body: Clear the snapshot and download entry point; require a fresh check.

sections.heading: Do Not Trust an Old Interface Flag at Export
paragraphs: In rules.py, export_report calls report, which first calls validate. Invalid data raises ValueError, so earlier interface success cannot by itself produce a report. Export selects only the three FIELDS keys, excluding debug or unagreed extra fields.

The downloaded JSON contains status, scope and data. complete means only teaching-field completeness; scope explicitly disclaims official intake acceptance. Values are trimmed, and the report exports Chinese content as UTF-8 to a file on the operator’s device.

blocks.heading: Controlled Export Example
paragraphs: This course-defined structure is not an official organizational format. The unchanged JSON uses status=complete, scope meaning “teaching-field completeness only, not official acceptance,” and data with application_id=SYN-001, applicant_code=DEMO-A and a synthetic application-form document_type.

sections.heading: Accept Complete, Clear and Correct Again
paragraphs: From the extracted root, enter reference, run tests, then start app.py. Enter three valid synthetic values, check, inspect the preview and download. Next clear document type and commit the change: the old complete result and download must disappear.

After correcting the field, check again. AppTest inspects state and elements; a real browser separately verifies download bytes, Chinese text and filename. A visible button alone does not establish correct file contents.

blocks.heading: Run Slice Three
paragraphs: Run separately from the first two stages, preserving the learner’s project.
blocks.code:
cd reference
python -m pytest -q
python -m streamlit run app.py --server.address 127.0.0.1

sections.heading: Do Not Expand Completeness into an Official Guarantee
paragraphs: Disabling a frontend button alone misses direct export calls. Clearing checked does not delete every downloaded file: session state and device files have different lifecycles. The operator still manages files already downloaded.

This course implements no login, multiuser authorization, persistent storage or secure-deletion mechanism. Record these limits in acceptance and handoff so successors know exactly what the local prototype demonstrates.

exercise.environment: Workshop reference/, a browser, pytest and your second slice.
steps: Add the snapshot, input-change invalidation, controlled report and export revalidation.
Test a complete record followed by clearing a field, plus direct export of invalid data; verify no complete report can be produced.
Download JSON in a real browser, check allowlisted fields, Chinese text and scope, and record actual results.
exercise.expected: app.py, rules.py, tests and download acceptance traceable to the same current input.
exercise.check: Old success cannot justify exporting new input. Extra keys stay out of reports, and downloaded files need separate management.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

zh.prompt: 為何只有 complete=True 不足？
options: 未指出成功對應哪份輸入
rationales: 可保存，問題是語意。
修改資料後無法確認對應關係。
JSON 支援布林。
需要明確狀態責任。

options: Boolean values cannot be stored in state.
It does not identify the input that passed.
rationales: They can be stored; the problem is meaning.
After an edit, the relationship to input is unknown.
JSON supports Booleans.
State responsibilities need an explicit design.

zh.prompt: 匯出函式收到缺件資料應怎麼做？
options: 重新驗證並拒絕產生完整報告
rationales: 舊狀態可能過期。
違反規格。
守住匯出邊界。
不能解決不合法資料。

en.prompt: What should export do with incomplete data?
options: Revalidate and refuse to produce a complete report.
rationales: The old state may be stale.
That violates the specification.
This protects the export boundary.
That does not make invalid data valid.

zh.prompt: 清除 Session State 的 checked 後，可以推定什麼？
options: 本次工作階段不再持有該檢查快照
rationales: 裝置檔案另有生命週期。
不是身分機制。
本課未實作多人控制。
推論限於被清除的狀態。

en.prompt: What follows from clearing checked in Session State?
options: This session no longer holds that checked snapshot.
rationales: Device files have their own lifecycle.
This is not an identity mechanism.
This course has not implemented those controls.
Keep the inference limited to the state removed.
